# @circle-fin/provider-borrow-service

## 1.0.3

### Patch Changes

- EURC address updates in chain definitions.

  - `WorldChain.eurcAddress` is now set; it was previously `null`.
  - The EURC addresses on Avalanche, Avalanche Fuji, and Base now use EIP-55 checksum casing instead of all lowercase. If you compare these addresses with `===`, compare them case-insensitively instead.
  - EURC can now be looked up by symbol on Avalanche Fuji and Solana Devnet.

## 1.0.2

### Patch Changes

- Arc Testnet calls no longer fail with `HTTP request failed` when no custom RPC is configured. The default Arc Testnet RPC endpoint is now `https://rpc.testnet.arc.io`, replacing the retired `https://rpc.testnet.arc.network/` host. Apps that already pass their own Arc Testnet RPC URL or transport are unaffected.

## 1.0.1

### Patch Changes

- More EVM contract reverts now include a readable reason instead of a raw
  error selector. The SDK now also looks for the selector in the error's cause
  chain, in browser wallet errors, and in viem's raw revert data.

## 1.0.0

### Major Changes

- Introduce `BorrowServiceProvider`, the Circle Borrow Service provider behind
  Borrow Kit on Arc and Arc Testnet. Borrow Kit selects it by chain, and it is
  installed automatically as a dependency of `@circle-fin/borrow-kit`; you do
  not need to construct it for the default configuration.
